title: Analytics
subtitle: Storefront traffic from Vercel Web Analytics. Admin pages are not counted.
updatedAt: Updated {time}. Numbers are cached for up to 5 minutes; days are counted in UTC.

kpi.increase: Up {value} compared with the previous period
kpi.decrease: Down {value} compared with the previous period

chart.title: Traffic
chart.empty: No traffic recorded in this period yet.
chart.ariaLabel: Line chart of visitors and page views over time

funnel.title: Shopping funnel
funnel.overall: {rate} of product views end in a purchase
funnel.empty: No shopping events recorded in this period yet.

breakdown.unavailable: This breakdown is unavailable right now.

notConfigured.title: Connect Vercel Web Analytics
notConfigured.description: Tracking is already running on the storefront. To read the numbers here, give the server read access to your Vercel project.

steps.token: Create a Vercel access token and save it as {token}.
steps.project: Set {projectId} to the project ID (Project, Settings, General). For a team project also set {teamId}.
steps.plan: Optionally set {plan} to hobby, pro, pro-plus or enterprise so this page only asks for data your plan includes. Default: hobby.

auth.title: Vercel refused the request
auth.message: The access token is invalid, expired, or has no access to this project. Check the token and project ID, then try again.

plan.title: Analytics not available
plan.message: Vercel says Web Analytics is not enabled for this project or your plan does not include it. Enable it in the Vercel dashboard (Analytics tab).

unavailable.title: Analytics is unavailable
unavailable.message: Vercel could not return the numbers right now. Please try again in a moment.

forbidden.title: Admins only
forbidden.message: Your account is not allowed to view analytics.

network.title: Could not load analytics
network.message: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
